annotations.title: Suspending a sole proprietorship in Poland: ZUS, taxes and dates

description: Use for suspending a sole proprietorship (zawieszenie działalności) in Poland: how long, ZUS and health contribution for the part month, PIT, lump-sum and VAT deadlines, VAT register after 6 months, childcare suspension. Give the inputs and the assumptions with the result. The result is a calculation from statutory rates. It is not advice. Suspension (zawieszenie) of a Polish sole proprietorship (JDG) registered in CEIDG under the Entrepreneurs Law: earliest end of the suspension (at least 30 days counting the first day, or a suspension covering only the whole of February), no upper limit for a standard suspension, latest end of a childcare suspension (up to 3 years, no later than the end of the year the child turns 6), ZUS social contributions for the month the suspension starts and the month of resumption with the base reduced pro rata to insured days (full ZUS with Labour Fund, preferential ZUS without it, start relief with none), minimum health contribution for a month with any business days, contributions and health contribution saved in fully suspended months, ZUS, PIT advance or lump-sum tax and monthly VAT return deadlines moved to the next working day, removal from the VAT register after at least 6 months of suspension and lump-sum tax due after resumption. Amounts use the contribution bases of the year of each month. Facts carry the act, article, link and verification date.
